hotlines.detail: Police, ambulance, and fire — unified emergency number across Saudi Arabia.

hotlines.label: MOH 937
hotlines.detail: Ministry of Health medical consultation and Seha support.

steps.title: Call 911 first if life is at risk
steps.detail: 911 reaches police, ambulance, and fire in every region. Stay on the line and give the city and a landmark.

steps.title: Ambulance is 997
steps.detail: If you already know you need the Red Crescent, 997 is the direct ambulance line.

steps.title: Non-emergency medical advice is 937
steps.detail: The Ministry of Health 937 line can point you to the right service when it is not an emergency.

steps.title: Go to the nearest hospital with an ER
steps.detail: This app lists nearby hospitals and clinics with map coordinates. Prefer a facility marked emergency when someone needs an ER.
